verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say its AI features are opt-in and "do not store or train on your data," with contractual no-training terms for its subprocessors. Organizations can block all AI features, but only by emailing support. This is a no-retention posture for AI processing plus a coarse opt-out, not user-facing control over retention or deletion. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, self-service deletion of stored data (PRs, chat history, insights), self-service AI disable controls, and independent corroboration.
